spans.s: anṛtaka, adj. or subst. m. (= anṛta; in vs, perhaps [] m.c.), lying or a liar: Ud 〔xx.19〕 satyenānṛtakaṃ jayet, one should conquer a liar (not le mensonge with Chakravarti; Pali alīkavādinaṃ; all the parallel words in the vs should also be taken as personal) by truth.
ānṛśaṃsa = anu˚, ānu˚, see s.v. anuśaṃsa.
